summary: Resolve the Office Portal attendance timeslot from a class and date when the caller omits the internal ID.
reason: Class search exposes schedules but not the tsId required by the roster endpoint, so the published attendance command could not be used from its own discoverable output.
validated_outcome: PASS: omitted timeslot discovery and explicit timeslot compatibility tests passed; full Go tests, go vet, go build, verify-skill, a live read-only roster smoke, 134/134 public dogfood checks, strict PII audit, supply-chain scan, and publish validation passed.
reapply_notes: Keep the optional fourth positional argument for backward compatibility. When it is absent, query /schedule/{class-id}/class/{date}/{date}, require one unique tsId for the requested date, and then read the existing roster endpoint.
